name: Tomita
source:
Kazuto's boss at the corporation he quit. Cool and collected, he will dispose of those deemed of no use without mercy.

His reputation in the eyes of the company manager is more important to him than anything else, and so he holds a grudge over Kazuto's resignation that caused a downturn in the assessment of his managerial skills.

[Translated from [url=http://venus66.sakura.ne.jp/tomita.html]the official site[/url]]
